layout: Split layout on desktop (left: brand illustration/pattern, right: form). Full-width single column on mobile. Clean, focused, minimal distractions.
elements: Header: 'Start Your Fitness Journey' in navy (#0B1B3B) h2, subtitle 'Create your account' in slate
Full name input — label above, placeholder 'Your full name'
Email input — label above, placeholder 'email@example.com', validation green checkmark on valid
Phone input — label above, with country code dropdown (+62 default), placeholder '81234567890'
Password input — label above, show/hide toggle icon, password strength bar below (Weak/Medium/Strong)
Referral code (optional) — smaller input with gift box icon, placeholder 'Kode referral (opsional)'
CTA button: 'Create Account' — orange (#FF8A34), full width, large
Below CTA: 'By signing up, you agree to our Terms and Privacy Policy' in small slate text
Social proof banner: 'Join 1,000+ seekers already on TrialFit' with small people icons
Toggle link at top: 'Sign Up as Buddy?' to switch role
notes: Large touch targets (min 48px). Clear labels, never placeholder-only. Password strength visible. Referral code optional and unobtrusive.
